I can't reproduce this on 4.5.beta 4ebf67c12 with the same code on a new project.

> Godot v4.5.beta (4ebf67c12) - macOS Sequoia (15.6.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Max (Apple9) - Apple M4 Max (16 threads) - 48.00 GiB memory

I've also tried Vulkan and OpenGL and neither crash on exit.

There could be a race condition in the de-initialization code. I can't repro the issue either. 

@beicause Do you get a stack trace when it crashes? If not, can you reproduce the crash in a debugger and give us the stack trace?

I cannot get a call stack from debugger (unnamed symbols).
